title: Simulation of a 6300 Year Intergalactic Journey
author: Thorsten Sommer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.676hhre
materials: Reset: Reset i.e. clear the entire simulation.
Determine year: Calculate the current mission year.

steps.title: Initialize Simulation Environment
steps.instruction: Set up the basic simulation parameters and visual representations.

substeps.instruction: Initialize all pens for both diagrams to allow selection between daily or monthly simulation.
Define spaceship capacity to a maximum of 500 people.
Import the two-dimensional spaceship representation from 'Spaceship.png', including the risk zone colors.

steps.title: Generate Initial Crew
steps.instruction: Create the starting population of males and females based on user interface parameters.

substeps.instruction: Create the first half of the crew as males: set color to blue, define date of death and age using a normal distribution from UI parameters, and set all as fertile.

Create the second half of the crew as females: set color to red, define date of death and age using a normal distribution from UI parameters, set all as fertile, and define the number of possible children and menopause onset using normal distributions from UI parameters. Set all females as not pregnant.
Correct any negative ages resulting from the normal distribution to a value between 0 and 365 days.

steps.title: Position and Initialize Crew Status
steps.instruction: Assign spatial locations and finalize fertility statistics for the crew.

substeps.instruction: Assign each crew member a random position within the spaceship, ensuring no one is positioned outside the spacecraft.
Count current males, females, and their fertility status to calculate initial infertility distribution.
Randomly distribute infertility status to the crew based on UI parameters.
Ensure that females marked as infertile cannot have children.
Recount sex and fertility to establish baseline mission statistics.

steps.title: Execute Daily/Monthly Simulation Tick
steps.instruction: Run the following sequence of actions for each simulation tick (one tick = one day).

substeps.instruction: Reset simulation ticks.
Check for natural deaths: mark members whose lifespan has expired as dead; increment age by one day or month for survivors.
Check for accidents: determine if an accident occurs (1% probability). If so, determine location: black area (70%), dark area (20%), gray area (8%), or white area (1%).
Determine accident fatalities: 30% in black area, 15% in dark area, 5% in gray area, and 1% in white area. Randomly select and mark affected crew members as dead.
Update sex and fertility counts after natural and unnatural deaths.

steps.title: Evaluate Mission Termination
steps.instruction: Check if the simulation should end based on time, population, or resources.

substeps.instruction: End mission if year 6300 is reached (survivors colonize planet).
End mission if crew count exceeds capacity limit (death by starvation, thirst, or suffocation).
End mission if all humans on the ship are extinct.

steps.title: Process Agent Actions and Reproduction
steps.instruction: Handle movement, pregnancy progression, births, and mating.

substeps.instruction: Move males randomly within the spaceship.
Move females randomly; progress pregnancies by 1 or 30 days.

Process births: terminate pregnancy and initiate birth. Determine if twins occur (1% probability) and assign sex (50/50 probability). Set newborn age to zero and assign parameters (death date, fertility, child limit, menopause) as per setup.

Determine mating potential: identify males of reproductive age. If dynamic control is enabled, reduce mating pool based on capacity: 80% capacity = 30% of males may mate; 90% capacity = 3 males may mate; 95%+ capacity = no reproduction.

Execute mating: selected males randomly choose suitable females (not pregnant, within reproductive age, younger than menopause). If both are fertile and female is under her child limit, intercourse occurs. Apply 75% probability of pregnancy.

steps.title: Finalize Tick and Update Data
steps.instruction: Ensure safety protocols and update simulation metrics.

substeps.instruction: Move all children under 17 years and all pregnant females to the safest area of the spacecraft.
Verify no crew members are positioned outside the spacecraft.
Update sex and fertility counts after births.
Calculate the average age of the crew.
Update the 'Population over time (last 365 days)' diagram by shifting the graph window.
Advance simulation time by one day or one month depending on configuration.
